title: academic-writer: A Claude Skill for Humanities and Social-Science Academic Writing
description: A Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK skill that turns Claude into a thinking partner for humanities and social-science academic writing — not a polishing tool, but an interlocutor that engages with arguments, concepts, and voice. Features four-layer critique (foundation/structure/paragraph/sentence), devil's-advocate mode with anti-sycophancy thresholds, deep-style preservation, reflexive-writing support for human-AI co-authoring research, ADHD-friendly interaction design, and engineering-grade infrastructure (version control, systematic validation, AI-trace scanning scripts).
references: Christou, P. A. (2026). Reconfiguring Reflexivity in the Era of AI: From 'Turning Back' to 'Looking Forward' Through Constructivist and Posthumanist Lenses. Qualitative Inquiry. https://doi.org/10.1177/10778004261445052
Wiles, F. (2025). Recursive Cognition in Practice: How AI Dialogue Generated and Analyzed Its Own Methodology. International Journal of Qualitative Methods. https://doi.org/10.1177/16094069251381709
Panke, S. (2025). How Can (A)I Research This? An Autoethnographic Exploration of Generative AI in Research, Teaching and Instructional Design. https://doi.org/10.1177/00224871251325065
